verdict.rationale: QuickBooks documents giving your accountant direct access to your books, and separately documents custom roles that control what others can see, so the core of inviting an accountant with scoped access is first-party. Custom access for up to 25 users is presented on the Advanced tier page. The docs frame accountant access around finding reports and information, not around adjusting entries, and nothing documents the actual invite flow or an accountant-specific role. missing for 10: explicit documentation that an invited accountant can adjust or post entries, a documented invite flow and accountant-specific role scope, clarity on which plans include role scoping, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can invite my external accountant or bookkeeper with role-scoped access to review and adjust the books

citations.quote: Give your accountant direct access to your books so she can find the reports and information she needs when questions arise.
Manage what others can see and set custom roles, workflows, and fields to find more efficiency.
custom access for up to 25 users
